entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Code generated by pattern matching includes unnecessary (duplicate) evaluations #82063
  • "Use coalesce expression" loses comments between variable declaration and if statement #82060

Closed

  • Improve error message for awaiting an IAsyncEnumerable value #53426
    Backlog
  • IDE0051 false positive for private (static) method in extension block #82061
  • Smart break line should not insert parentheses if I didn't type them #80753
  • Performance regression in VS2026 in AvoidPassingTaskWithoutCancellationTokenAnalyzer #82055
  • "Use coalesce expression" drops trivia #82037
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Merge 'main' in 'features/collection-expression-args' #82065
    VSCode
  • Support inserting initializers with smart break line for target-typed `new()` #82064
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Keep comments when converting coalesce expressions #82062
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add more details to stale project update warning #82053
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Closed classes 2 #82052

Merged

  • Add more collection expression tests #82056
  • Add dedicated diagnostic for awaiting an `IAsyncEnumerable` #82057
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Don't insert parenthesis in smart break line if user didn't type them #82059
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Adds an analyzer/fixer to inform the user when the compiler silently inserts a fallible explicit cast. #82039
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 2881433 #82054
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Don't offer "Use coalesce expression" when if-statement contains directives #82041
    VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Features/collection expression arguments #81924
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: handle remaining member kinds #82043
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Extension indexers: nullability analysis #81971
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Change logic for how we cache GeneratorDrivers to avoid initialization #81323
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use document structure in breadcrumbs, sticky scroll, and outline in VSCode #81993
    VSCode
  • Delete Solution.WithCachedSourceGeneratorState #82050
    Area-IDE, VSCode
